geometry_or_control_changes: None. Geometry, physical parameters/evaluator, thirteen initial finger targets, three control resources, three experience records and 160/48 budgets remain identical.
infrastructure_changes: FileBackend atomically replaces JSON with bounded retries only for Windows PermissionError5/32: at most50 attempts and0.49s retry waiting per publication. No action is reread or reexecuted. Permanent final-status errors become FileBackendError with cause; run loop records OSError rather than leaving summary.error null. A failed decide can perform more than one bounded status publication.
workflow: Same clarified completed-image-result-before-separate-action-publication workflow and image-review records as confirmation-v1. Only infrastructure source and its regression tests change; no previous primary/confirmation action trace or experience is supplied to the new actor.
image_review_record: Same actor/image-reviews/NNN.json fields: request_id, sequence, observation_sha256, ordered image_sha256 pair, result_received_before_reply=true and visual_review after inspecting a completed read-only image result. All online replies/selections and handoff/finish covered; published local microactions retain state-feedback exception. No fabricated timestamps/tool IDs.
acceptance: Complete unchanged physical/quality gates with accepted finish and no runtime error; frozen-source/local trace/calibrated-grasp/memory/high-target checks pass; image-review bindings/attestations consistent and actor reports no ordering deviations, with independent procedural review. File receipts do not independently authenticate model perception/timing.
attempts: One new fresh-actor confirmation. Previous physical/procedural and infrastructure outcomes stay unchanged. This is not a new held-out geometry or a replacement original primary.
root_role: Launch/bind/monitor/file-reading support only; no robot strategies or action edits.
scope: Reproducible operation of one already known longer/heavier wrench after workflow and transport-layer fixes; no population, unseen-category, vision-only or hardware claim.
external_services: No external model APIs, remote jobs or private-arm simulation.
